name: csb-vendor-safe
description: Safe 1.4.1 artifacts, installed in isolation. Safe peer-depends on ethers 5.4.0 while this project runs ethers 6, so installing it into the root tree either fails peer resolution or (with --no-save) prunes hardhat's own dependencies. Its own package.json gives npm a separate tree to resolve, so the root install stays untouched and needs no flags.
